title: Jobs API hooks + types
description: useJobs(filters), useJob(id), useJobDecisions(id), useCancelJob(), useRetryJob() mutations.
definitionOfDone: useJobs(filters) with pagination, sorting, and filter params
useJobDecisions(id) for safety decisions on a job

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/useJobs.ts: useJobs(filters: JobFilters) React Query hook — fetches GET /api/v1/jobs with query params for pagination, sorting, and filters (state, pool, topic, decision, timeRange, tenant). Returns paginated response. useJob(id) for single job detail (GET /api/v1/jobs/:id). useJobDecisions(id) for safety decisions on a job (GET /api/v1/jobs/:id/decisions). useCancelJob() mutation (POST /api/v1/jobs/:id/cancel) with cache invalidation of ['jobs'] and ['job', id]. useRetryJob() mutation (POST /api/v1/jobs/:id/retry) with same invalidation. JobFilters type: { state?: JobStatus[], pool?: string, topic?: string, decision?: string[], timeRange?: string, tenant?: string, page?: number, perPage?: number, sort?: string }. All use apiClient with auth headers.
